outline.text: Strategy: Step 1: Check local DB (fast,free) → Step 2: IF found → Use result → Step 3: IF not found → Check cache → Step 4: IF not cached → Call API → Step 5: Cache result (TTL 7 days)
Caching: Key=vps_check_{IP}, Value={is_vps, vps_provider,datacenter_info}, TTL=7 days, Storage: Redis/Memcached/WP transients
Benefits: ✓ 95% requests dùng local DB ✓ 5% dùng API (cached sau đó) ✓ Giảm costs ✓ Giảm latency
